text: Peter and Marcia drive with their dog Cricket to [a secluded beach for a weekend's camping|trigger|travelling somewhere remote], bickering all the way over affairs and an abortion. At the edge of the woods they [steal an eagle's egg, kill a dugong and hack at trees|wrong|harming the natural world], and slowly the land answers, first with [an eagle and a possum that attack Peter|threat|nature turning on us], then by stranger means. Alone at night with a spear-gun, Peter fires blindly at a noise in the dark.
